parameters.mask: F32 [key,32,1,1]; mask[j,t]=-infinity for t>key-q+j, zero otherwise

fix.changes: Only allow batch-3 broadcast for plain MUL_MAT, F16 x F32, contiguous source A, A.batch=1, B.batch=2 or 4, B.columns=1, equal head dimension
fix.shaders: 147 unchanged precompiled shader objects reused from frozen local build; full object SHA256 list recorded, C++ dispatch/support source rebuilt
fix.native_path: Existing mat-vec broadcast3 push constant/indexing; noncontiguous Q is packed by existing backend path; its runtime cost stays in measured graph
fix.KV: Original K and V object identities asserted; no REPEAT graph nodes allowed; no K/V replication or padding

budget.charge: Entire native process wall including device init, file I/O, numerical reference, shader initialization, staging and cleanup

timing.clock: Host steady clock graph compute plus explicit backend synchronization
timing.order: QB then QH_C on even rounds, QH_C then QB on odd rounds
timing.excluded: Setup, allocation, upload, CPU reference and explicit readback
timing.included: Backend graph dispatch and any internal Q staging/copy. Cold first-graph time separately retained.
timing.claims: Exploratory only; no GPU timestamp, model latency or cross-device speedup claim
